title: SpaceX, AT&T, T-Mobile, Verizon, EchoStar among AWS-3 auction winners
content: The Big Three, EchoStar and SpaceX were all winners in the AWS-3 spectrum auction. SpaceX could use it to set up a trial network in Cincinnati and set the stage for a bigger move into terrestrial wireless, says analyst Roger Entner.

title: FCC tees up broadband permit battle between 'competing interests'
content: The FCC will hold a rulemaking proceeding to seek input on if and how it can limit state and local fees and timelines for broadband permitting. ISP groups cheered the measure, though the FCC's legal authority here is unclear.

title: SK Telecom to invest $480M in US AI
content: Korean operator SK Telecom plans a $480 million investment in SK Hynix's US subsidiary, and already has a $2.5 billion Anthropic holding ahead of the AI firm's IPO.

title: PLDT subsidiary Vitro seeks name change ahead of $395M public listing
content: PLDT is seeking Philippine SEC approval to change the name of its data center unit to Vitro REIT. The company plans to raise $395 million through a REIT IPO.

title: California PUC challenges FCC copper retirement rules
content: The California Public Utilities Commission has asked a court to determine if the FCC's new rules for shutting down copper networks is an overreach that violates federal law and the Administrative Procedure Act.
